---
name: "nf-core/bam_dedup_stats_samtools_umicollapse"
description: "umicollapse, index BAM file and run samtools stats, flagstat and idxstats"
keywords:
- "umi"
- "dedup"
- "index"
- "bam"
- "sam"
- "cram"
components:
- "umicollapse"
- "samtools/index"
- "samtools/stats"
- "samtools/idxstats"
- "samtools/flagstat"
- "bam_stats_samtools"
input:
- ch_bam_bai:
    description: "input BAM file and its index\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam),\
      \ path(bai) ]\n"
output:
- bam:
    description: "Umi deduplicated BAM/SAM file\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam)\
      \ ]\n"
- index:
    description: "Umi deduplicated BAM/SAM samtools index (BAI or CSI)\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- dedup_stats:
    description: "File containing umicollapse deduplication stats\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(stats) ]\n"
- stats:
    description: "File containing samtools stats output\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(stats)\
      \ ]\n"
- flagstat:
    description: "File containing samtools flagstat output\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(flagstat) ]\n"
- idxstats:
    description: "File containing samtools idxstats output\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(idxstats) ]\n"
authors:
- "@MatthiasZepper"
maintainers:
- "@MatthiasZepper"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/umicollapse@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/index@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/bam_stats_samtools@0.0.0-df69bf6"
